published_results.claim: The calibrated verifier reports 10/15 first-pass usable, with five deterministic visual-quality failures and no semantic or operational failures.
published_results.metric: firstPassUsable (semantic + `validate --quality showcase` + identified visual review all pass on attempt 1)

published_results.claim: Under that same current verifier, both the original matrix and the post-fix matrix score 8/15: the single sample does **not** demonstrate an overall uplift.
published_results.metric: firstPassUsable after verifier tightening, before vs after a fix
published_results.baseline: 8/15 (original matrix reverified with current verifier; originally recorded as 10/15)

published_results.claim: The post-fix distribution is MiniMax 4/5, DeepSeek 2/5, and Qwen 2/5.
published_results.metric: firstPassUsable per model (minimax-m3, deepseek-v4-flash, qwen3.7-plus per results JSON)

published_results.claim: Reverification keeps the overall result at 8/15 (MiniMax 3/5, Qwen 3/5, DeepSeek 2/5), so it still does **not** demonstrate an overall uplift. The targeted lifecycle case improves from 0/3 to 1/3 and the architecture case from 2/3 to 3/3, while workflow and data-flow regress in this sample.
published_results.metric: firstPassUsable, quality-first run vs prior runs

published_results.claim: No published numbers. "how efficiently do Archify receipts let a caller converge to a passing artifact?" (rounds to pass, first-round disclosure rate, observable token cost)
published_results.metric: Repair rounds, defect disclosure, lexical token estimate on synthetic injected defects

summary: Archify publishes three committed 15-run matrices (3 models x 5 tasks) from its ordinary-model-floor benchmark, with per-run receipts and a runnable verifier and report harness. The first run recorded 10/15 first-pass usable; under the current verifier the original, post-fix and quality-first matrices each score 8/15, and the README states that the fixes do not demonstrate an overall uplift (lifecycle improved from 0/3 to 1/3 and architecture from 2/3 to 3/3, while workflow and data-flow regressed). Candidate generation uses an external runner and model providers that the repository does not ship, so the numbers can be re-verified from the committed candidates but not regenerated end to end from this checkout. A second harness, repair-rounds, has no published results.
result_focus_note: manual classification of published_results: outcome = does the tool do its job; engineering = speed of the software itself
